name: io.github.svergio/chat-export-server
title: Chat Export
description: Local MCP for eight logged-in LLM UIs via the Chat Export Chrome extension on 127.0.0.1.

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_EXPORT_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Data directory for SQLite cache, keys and exports

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_EXPORT_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional pre-set MCP Bearer token (cem_…); otherwise generated on first start

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_EXPORT_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind host (default 127.0.0.1; use 0.0.0.0 in containers)
